summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of VoucherKu new features (cookie-only auth, store settings, expiry warning, bulk prefix). Backend: 17/17 pytest tests passed covering cookie-only login (no token in response, /me works with cookie, /me with Bearer-only header returns 401, logout clears cookies), settings GET/PUT with role gating (kasir can GET but PUT returns 403), settings validation (expiry_warning_days 0 and 400 both rejected), bulk prefix (lowercase 'rm' -> RM..., 5-char prefix rejected, non-alnum 'A-B' rejected, empty prefix produces 10-char code, serial increments), expiry warning stats (expiry_warning_days=10 with 5-day voucher yields expiring_soon>=1), and redeem regression via cookie auth. Frontend: Login sets httpOnly cookies with no localStorage 'token', session persists across reloads, /admin/settings page renders all required data-testids (input-store-prefix/name/branch/promo-line1/2/expiry-warning-days, btn-save-settings, settings-print-preview), live preview updates as user types (verified 'TOKO MAJU 99', 'PUSAT', promo lines appear in preview), save shows toast and values persist after reload, print card [data-testid=print-voucher-card] under print media emulation contains updated store_name/branch/promo lines, voucher list shows amber 'Segera Kadaluarsa · N hari' badges for active vouchers expiring within threshold (visible on EXZ6JD3017 5d, RM4BJWF012 5d, RMYMUEJ011 5d), CreateVoucher prefix input auto-uppercases and strips non-alnum ('a-b1' -> 'AB1'), submitting with prefix 'pr' qty 2 produces two 10-char codes starting with 'PR', logout endpoint returns 200 and subsequent /me returns 401. All settings restored to defaults after tests.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby (a11y warning, non-blocking)

critical_code_review_comments: Settings.js useEffect unconditionally overwrites form state on fetch resolution: if user starts typing before /api/settings responds, their input can be wiped. Consider guarding with a 'loaded' flag or only setting form when form still equals DEFAULT_SETTINGS. Reproduced during first UI test iteration - re-navigating with wait_for_load_state('networkidle') worked around it.

server.py generate_voucher_code: when prefix length is 4, random_part length becomes 3 which reduces entropy considerably (3 chars from 36-char set = 46,656 combos before serial). With sequence appended it's still unique but the collision risk in the unique index means potential 500s on duplicates. Consider pre-checking or falling back.
server.py create_vouchers uses find_one_and_update on counter without index; fine at low volume but consider indexed counter collection.

PrintVoucher.js store_name regex splits trailing digits into a smaller-font suffix (e.g. 'ANEKA 88' -> 'ANEKA' + '88'). This is by design but 'TOKO MAJU 99' rendered as 'TOKO MAJU99' (space collapsed by regex). Minor cosmetic - the space between name and number is lost.
